title: When the Orbit Wakes
author: I. M. Galloway
blurb: Felix Ravensworth, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
